name: Controlled-rate freezing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells
description: Initial PBMC preservation thermal program, distinct from frozen tissue slicing and fluorescence microscopy. Compatibility concerns the stated equipment requirements; no viability claim is fabricated.

sources.citation: Angel et al.2016, Biopreservation and Biobanking, DOI10.1089/bio.2016.0046

requirements.rationale: Freezing viable cell suspensions requires the selected cooling program, not simply a low base temperature.
Replicate the reported +4 to-80 C initial freezing window.
Replicate the reported1 C/min cooling magnitude.

missing_information: The study used MrFrosty containers; a programmable freezer is an alternative thermal implementation, not a published biological-equivalence result.
Cryomedium,1mL fill,cell density and post-thaw functional assays are essential procedural conditions outside Lean's current quantitative acceptance scope.
Subsequent storage below-135 C requires separate verified equipment.
confirmation_note: Source-specific requirements reviewed by the catalog author on 2026-10-31. They describe the selected procedure, not a universal limit. Users must confirm them before a run; edits require confirmation again.
